'''Armin Devonan''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] employee of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the<ref name="Mission" /> [[Galactic War]] waged between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="1.7 Blog">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20130205|text=Game Update 1.7 Developer Blog: Galactic Reputation}}</ref> She had a similar level of cybernetic enhancements to that of the cybernecrotic thralls in the [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7]], but appeared to be able to control her own actions.

She maintained the communications tower in the Czerka courtyard, and held the Czerka security manifest for Czerka's facilities in the area. Devonan was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] by Imperial forces who took the files, but not before the Imperials had to steal a Czerka [[Electromagnetic pulse launcher|ion round]] from the courtyard to destroy the main structure of the tower on which the Czerka employee stood, forcing Devonan from her metal platform which she was repairing into a lethal confrontation.<ref name="Mission" />

Armin Devonan sported a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and a light [[Leather/Legends|leather]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] popular with the Corellians Rebels that resisted the Imperial occupation. She was also equipped with [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] and a repair tool which emmitted a [[Color/Legends|red]]-beam.<ref name="Mission" />
